name: copilot-cost-counter
description: Record Copilot request usage and cost summaries from its output log.

commands.title: Copilot Cost Counter: Choose Output Log
Copilot Cost Counter: Open Workspace Usage
Copilot Cost Counter: Refresh Usage Report

copilotCostCounter.logPath.markdownDescription: Optional path override for the GitHub Copilot output log. Leave empty (recommended) to discover the active VS Code window's Copilot Chat logs automatically; the discovered path is not stored in this setting.

copilotCostCounter.pollIntervalMs.markdownDescription: How often to check the Copilot output log for completed requests.

copilotCostCounter.showMoneyBurn.markdownDescription: Show a brief money-burn animation after a request with an estimated cost is recorded.

copilotCostCounter.moneyBurnThresholdUsd.markdownDescription: Accumulate estimated spend and show the money-burn animation each time this USD threshold is crossed. Set to 0 to show it for every estimated request.

copilotCostCounter.moneyBurnDurationMs.markdownDescription: Duration of the money-burn animation in milliseconds.

copilotCostCounter.moneyBurnSizePx.markdownDescription: Font size of the money-burn amount in pixels.

copilotCostCounter.moneyBurnOrigin.markdownDescription: Screen corner where the money-burn animation starts.

copilotCostCounter.currency.markdownDescription: Currency used when displaying estimated money values. Pricing rates and stored costs remain in USD; configure a conversion rate separately if using a non-USD display.

copilotCostCounter.currencyConversionRat.markdownDescription: Display-currency units per USD. For example, enter 0.92 for EUR if one USD equals 0.92 EUR.

copilotCostCounter.modelPricingOverrides.markdownDescription: Optional per-model USD rates per million tokens. Add any model name as a property; values support input and output, plus optional cachedInput and cacheWrite.

scripts.package: npm run backup-codebase && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node ./scripts/update-readme-version.mjs && npm run test && mkdir -p packages && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --out packages/copilot-cost-counter-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").vsix
